loop.top3_why: Candidate B uses a median combination over the full pool, which is robust to outlying model errors and aligns with the diagnosis that model ranking is unstable across windows. The mean combination in A suffers from a very large positive error in the last window (1.5), suggesting sensitivity to a few poor models. The mean combination in C also shows a large positive error (1.8) in the last window. Therefore B is expected to generalize best to the blind test window.
loop.top3_why_not: Candidate A’s mean over pool3 has a large positive error in the last window, indicating instability. Candidate C’s mean over pool1 also shows a large positive error in the last window. Both are less robust than the median strategy of B, especially given the unstable model ranking and the presence of correlated errors among models. Hence they are less suitable for this trend‑dominated, highly predictable series.
